snippet_primary: "The standard fee you will pay is 15% on Attributed Orders, unless the 12% fee applies as described below. If your shop has made less than $10,000 USD in sales over the prior 365 days (going back to February 20, 2019 and later), as calculated on the first day of the month, you will pay a fee of 15% (as described in the section below) on Attributed Orders, unless you opt out of participation in Offsite Ads for the duration your shop is under the $10,000 USD threshold."
subject_exact: Etsy Offsite Ads standard fee rate for shops below the $10,000 sales threshold
local_qualifiers: going back to February 20, 2019 and later
unless opted out while under threshold
